name: Selldone
title: selldone.com
shortDescription: Selldone is an enterprise-grade, no-code business operating system designed to streamline the management and scaling of businesses. It supports handling millions of orders and automates workflow processes. Ideal for non-technical founders, it allows users to focus on sales and operations without worrying about the technical complexities. Example use case: A startup can use Selldone to manage their entire online store operations, including order processing, inventory management, and customer relations, all from one platform.
cons: Limited customization due to no-code nature
